# SYNTHETIC machine (not a hardware capture): 65 CPU-bearing NUMA nodes, one
# core each -- one more than IREE_TASK_TOPOLOGY_MAX_NODES (64). A
# --task_topology_nodes selection cannot name them all, so selection must fail
# with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED rather than silently using the first 64 nodes and
# leaving the rest of the machine idle.
